findings: Accept the repository's real raw-byte RequirementsBaseline digest contract. When an input supplies value/ref/bytes, verify sha256(bytes) equals ref.digest and that parsing bytes reproduces value before deriving coverage. Do not compare a pretty-printed raw digest to canonicalJsonDigest(value). Preserve closed semantic-digest validation for direct digest-bound artifacts.

Use exactly the same business-scope identity algorithm as the trusted RequirementsBaseline traceability contributor. Add a cross-slice test that projects the same approved scope statement through requirements traceability and proves Core's derived scopeId equals the graph node stableId.
Reject a graph snapshot unless its exact loaded bytes/ref/checkpoint and graph envelope are valid; preserve zero-call replay and all prior substitution failures.
